## Sumsub - Senior Backend Developer – Travel Rule

🔗 [Apply](https://careers.sumsub.com/jobs/8097614-senior-backend-developer-travel-rule)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Backend Engineer developing backend services for the Travel Rule product at Sumsub. Involved in integrations and distributed systems in a remote-first, global environment.
Senior Backend Engineer creating backend services for the Travel Rule product in a remote-first company.
- Tech stack: Distributed Systems, Java, MongoDB
- Design and develop backend services for the Travel Rule product.
- Build and maintain integrations with third-party providers.
- Work with asynchronous, event-driven architectures.
- Ensure high reliability, fault tolerance, and observability of distributed services.
- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to evolve the platform.
- Strong backend engineering experience (Java or similar languages).
- Experience building and maintaining integrations with external systems and third-party APIs.
- Familiarity with asynchronous processing and distributed systems.
- Good understanding of databases (MongoDB, ClickHouse, or similar).
- Motivated to solve complex, product-driven problems.
- Bonus: familiarity with crypto, blockchain fundamentals, or how crypto networks and wallets operate.

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Backend Engineer developing backend services for the Travel Rule product at Sumsub. Involved in integrations and distributed systems in a remote-first, global environment.
Senior Backend Engineer creating backend services for the Travel Rule product in a remote-first company.
Role description:
• Design and develop backend services for the Travel Rule product.
• Build and maintain integrations with third-party providers.
• Work with asynchronous, event-driven architectures.
• Ensure high reliability, fault tolerance, and observability of distributed services.
• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to evolve the platform.
Role requirements:
• Strong backend engineering experience (Java or similar languages).
• Experience building and maintaining integrations with external systems and third-party APIs.
• Familiarity with asynchronous processing and distributed systems.
• Good understanding of databases (MongoDB, ClickHouse, or similar).
• Motivated to solve complex, product-driven problems.
• Bonus: familiarity with crypto, blockchain fundamentals, or how crypto networks and wallets operate.
Benefits:
• Remote-first, trust-based culture.
• True flexibility in working hours.
• Extra time off including birthday holiday and personal days.
• Dedicated financial bonuses for life's biggest moments like marriage and welcoming a new baby.
• Professional development opportunities and role-specific events.
• Team offsites fully covered.
• Friendly and inclusive workplace culture.
Tech stack:
Distributed Systems, Java, MongoDB
